null_safety_findings.details: Strict adherence to Null Invariant: unknown != 0.0. Omitted or unmentioned fields map strictly to null, never 0.0. Explicit zero is preserved as 0.0. Unmentioned debt is correctly mapped to null rather than hallucinating 'no debt'.

split_leakage_findings.details: All examples sharing the same template_id reside exclusively within a single partition (train, val, or test). Zero template contamination exists between train and evaluation sets.

corrections_made.rationale: Aligned debt_status from 'no debt' to null where input text contained no mention of debt. Matches controlled template expected_slot_behavior, preserves the Null Invariant (unmentioned != default enum), avoids training the NLU to hallucinate debt absence, and retains identical ConsultantEngine rule outcomes.

warnings: Intent 'savings_question' is defined in templates (T_SAVINGS_003, T_SAVINGS_005, T_SAVINGS_007) but has 0 records in the dry run.
Slot 'spending_habit' has 0% non-null annotations in the dry run.
Marital status 'Single' is not represented in the dry run (only 'Married' is present in 1 record).

identified_risks.description: Risk that synthetic pipelines or annotators fill missing slots with default engine assumptions rather than extracting verbatim evidence.
identified_risks.mitigation: Automated validation enforces that slots unmentioned in input_text evaluate strictly to null in NLU labels.

identified_risks.description: Zero examples for savings_question could cause the future model to misclassify savings inquiries into generic financial_consultation.
identified_risks.mitigation: Allocate 8-10 records to savings_question in the controlled expansion batch.

identified_risks.description: Zero non-null examples for spending_habit prevents perception of discretionary spending intensity.
identified_risks.mitigation: Mandate at least 15 examples featuring 'average spend' and 'big spend' statements in the expansion batch.

identified_risks.description: Risk that annual salaries or hourly wages are mistakenly converted into monthly figures.
identified_risks.mitigation: Automated audit checks reject any dataset record attempting arithmetic cadence conversion.

identified_risks.description: Risk that third-party financial figures (e.g. brother's salary) are extracted as user income.
identified_risks.mitigation: Strict span and slot checks prevent non-user financial amounts from populating user slots.

recommended_improvements: Execute Controlled Expansion Batch 1 to reach a target of 100 high-quality records (78 new records).
Allocate balanced records across all 9 canonical intents, ensuring 'savings_question' receives proportional representation.
Introduce explicit examples for discretionary spending tiers ('big spend' and 'average spend').
Maintain strict template-grouped split partitioning to guarantee zero train-to-test leakage.
